arxiv-2103-10322.title: Evidence for Higgs boson decays to a low-mass dilepton system and a photon in p ​ p pp collisions at s = 13 \sqrt{s}=13 TeV with the ATLAS detector
arxiv-2103-10322.creator: The ATLAS Collaboration
arxiv-2103-10322.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by The ATLAS Collaboration. A search for the Higgs boson decaying into a photon and a pair of electrons or muons with an invariant mass m ℓ ​ ℓ < 30 m_{\ell\ell}<30 GeV is presented. The analysis is performed using 139 fb -1 of proton–proton collision data, produced by the LHC at a centre-of-mass energy of 13 TeV and collected by the ATLAS experiment.

Chatzakou is a postdoctoral fellow of the Research Foundation – Flanders (FWO) under the postdoctoral grant No 12B1223N. A. Dasgupta is supported by Core Research Grant, RP03890G, Science and Engin
arxiv-2304-10275.creator: Marianna Chatzakou, Aparajita Dasgupta, Michael Ruzhansky, Abhilash Tushir
arxiv-2304-10275.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Marianna Chatzakou, Aparajita Dasgupta, Michael Ruzhansky, Abhilash Tushir. In this paper, we consider a semi-classical version of the nonhomogeneous heat equation with singular time-dependent coefficients on the lattice ℏ ​ ℤ n \hbar\mathbb{Z}^{n} . We establish the well-posedeness of such Cauchy equations in the classical sense when regular coefficients are considered, and analyse how the notion of very weak solution adapts in such equations when distributional coefficients are regarded.

arxiv-2306-05705.title: On the Challenges and Perspectives of Foundation Models for Medical Image Analysis
arxiv-2306-05705.creator: Shaoting Zhang, Dimitris Metaxas
arxiv-2306-05705.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Shaoting Zhang, Dimitris Metaxas. This article discusses the opportunities, applications and future directions of large-scale pretrained models, i.e., foundation models, which promise to significantly improve the analysis of medical images. Medical foundation models have immense potential in solving a wide range of downstream tasks, as they can help to accelerate the development of accurate and robust models, reduce the dependence on large amounts of labeled data, preserve the privacy and confidentiality of patient data.

arxiv-2307-02796.title: VerifAI: Verified Generative AI
arxiv-2307-02796.creator: Nan Tang, Chenyu Yang, Ju Fan, Lei Cao, Yuyu Luo, Alon Halevy
arxiv-2307-02796.description: Abstract . Generative AI has made significant strides, yet concerns about the accuracy and reliability of its outputs continue to grow. Such inaccuracies can have serious consequences such as inaccurate decision-making, the spread of false information, privacy violations, legal liabilities, and more.

Biddle, Sebastiaan Y. Haffert, Marta L. Bryan
arxiv-2502-14024.description: Abstract Understanding the processes of planet formation and accretion in young systems is essential to unraveling the initial conditions of planetary systems. The PDS 70 system, which hosts two directly imaged protoplanets, provides a unique laboratory for studying these phenomena, particularly through H α \alpha emission, a commonly used accretion tracer.

arxiv-2503-11440.title: Variational Diagrammatic Monte-Carlo Built on Dynamical Mean-Field Theory
arxiv-2503-11440.creator: Yueyi Wang, Kristjan Haule †
arxiv-2503-11440.description: Abstract We develop a variational perturbation expansion around dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT) that systematically incorporates nonlocal correlations beyond the local correlations treated by DMFT. We apply this approach to investigate how the DMFT critical temperature is suppressed from its mean-field value and how the critical behavior near the finite-temperature phase transition evolves from the mean-field to the Heisenberg universality class.

arxiv-2510-07995.title: Quantum Max-Cut is NP-hard to approximate
arxiv-2510-07995.creator: Stephen Piddock
arxiv-2510-07995.description: Abstract We unconditionally prove that it is NP-hard to compute a constant multiplicative approximation to the Quantum Max-Cut problem on an unweighted graph of constant bounded degree. The proof works in two stages: first a generic reduction to computing the optimal value of a quantum problem, from the optimal value over product states.

pmc-11459142.title: Investigating the cis-regulatory basis of C3 and C4 photosynthesis in grasses at single-cell resolution
pmc-11459142.creator: John Pablo Mendieta, Xiaoyu Tu, Daiquan Jiang, Haidong Yan, Xuan Zhang, Alexandre P. Marand, Silin Zhong, Robert J. Schmitz
pmc-11459142.description: SignificanceThis study advances understanding of the cis-regulatory mechanisms underpinning the evolution of C3 and C4 photosynthesis in grasses. Leveraging cutting-edge single-cell assay for transposase accessible chromatin-sequencing technology, we reveal intricate cell-type-specific regulatory landscapes that delineate the evolutionary trajectory from C3 to C4 photosynthesis.

pmc-11594128.title: Accuracy of Genomic Predictions Cross Populations with Different Linkage Disequilibrium Patterns
pmc-11594128.creator: Lei Jin, Lei Xu, Hai Jin, Shuanping Zhao, Yutang Jia, Junya Li, Jinling Hua, Chunjin Li
pmc-11594128.description: Background/Objectives: There is a considerable global population of beef cattle, with numerous small-scale groups. Establishing separate reference groups for each breed in breeding practices is challenging, severely limiting the genome selection (GS) application. Combining data from multiple populations becomes particularly attractive and practical for small-scale populations, offering increased reference population size, operational ease, and data sharing.

pmc-12371744.title: Evaluating Melanoma Risk in Adult Mastocytosis: Potential Impact of Detection Bias – A Registry-based Study (Sweden)
pmc-12371744.creator: Anna BERGSTRÖM, Hans HÄGGLUND, Anders BERGLUND, Gunnar NILSSON, Mats LAMBE
pmc-12371744.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). There is some evidence that mastocytosis patients are at increased risk of skin cancer. This study aimed to assess the risk of malignant melanoma (MM), melanoma in situ (Mis), and basal cell carcinoma (BCC). A dataset was generated by individual-level record linkages between Swedish population registers including the National Patient Register (NPR), the Swedish Cancer Register (SCR), and the Population Register (PR). Adult patients with a mastocytosis diagnosis between 2001 and 2018 were identified in the SCR and NPR.

pmc-12524375.title: Combined Treatment of Sodium Butyrate and Bromelain Enhanced Anticancer Effects in Colorectal Cancer Cell Lines: A Promising Therapeutic Approach
pmc-12524375.creator: Rocío Olivera-Salazar, Pedro Villarejo Campos, Rocío Barrueco Gutiérrez, Luz Vega-Clemente, Luis Javier Serrano, Soledad García Gómez-Heras, Damián García-Olmo, Mariano García-Arranz
pmc-12524375.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Colorectal cancer (CRC) is one of the most prevalent and lethal cancers worldwide, with few effective treatment options and substantial associated side effects. As a result, there is growing interest in therapeutic alternatives that reduce toxicity. Natural compounds such as sodium butyrate (NaB), a microbial metabolite of dietary fiber, and bromelain, a proteolytic enzyme from pineapple, have shown individual anticancer properties. However, their combined effect in CRC remains underexplored.

pmc-12581086.title: Pulmonary vascular complications in children who survive long-term after Kasai portoenterostomy for biliary atresia: a narrative review
pmc-12581086.creator: Jie Zhang, Gong Chen
pmc-12581086.description: Following Kasai portoenterostomy for biliary atresia (BA), long-term survival in children is associated with chronic liver cirrhosis leading to hepatopulmonary syndrome (HPS) and portopulmonary hypertension (PoPH). This further causes a diverse array of respiratory and circulatory symptoms. The incidence of these complications in children with BA is higher than that seen in other chronic liver diseases.

pmc-13030303.title: Enhanced Security of Bidirectional Communication in IoT-Driven Utility Networks Using Sertainty UXP and LoRaWAN
pmc-13030303.creator: Zaheen Afroz Simin, Semih Aslan, Marcelo M. Carvalho, Damian Valles
pmc-13030303.description: LoRaWAN holds immense potential in smart applications for its low-power, long-range communication capabilities and in-built AES-128 encryption for end-to-end security. However, prior research has identified critical security vulnerabilities, most notably its use of AES-128 encryption in ECB mode, which lacks semantic security. Sertainty UXP (Unbreakable Exchange Protocol) technology enhances AES by embedding intelligence directly into the data.

pmc-13388240.title: 细针吸取细胞学检查和细针吸取洗脱液降钙素测定诊断甲状腺髓样癌荟萃分析
pmc-13388240.creator: Jianhua ZHANG, Junkang YU, Chenhao HUANG, Minghuang ZHANG, Kanghui ZHANG, Ning MENG, 方 余, 丽娜 刘
pmc-13388240.description: 目的系统性评价细针吸取细胞学检查（FNAC）、细针吸取洗脱液降钙素测定（FNA-CT）对甲状腺髓样癌（MTC）的诊断价值。方法检索中英文数据库中公开发表的有关FNAC、FNA-CT诊断MTC的相关文献，检索时限为1995年1月1日至2024年12月31日。采用QUADAS-2量表评价纳入文献质量，应用Stata 16.0软件进行荟萃分析，采用Spearman秩相关检验评估阈值效应，采用Cochran’s Q检验及I²统计量评价异质性，并根据异质性大小选择固定效应模型或随机效应模型。基于所选模型，结合敏感度、特异度、阳性似然比、阴性似然比及诊断比值比绘制汇总受试者操作特征曲线（SROC）和森林图，以评估诊断效能。进一步采用meta回归分析探讨异质性来源，绘制Deeks漏斗图评估发表偏倚，并采用Fagan图和似然比点状图评价临床效用。结果最终纳入13篇文献进行分析，共937例患者，444个MTC病变。Spearman秩相关检验显示，FNAC诊断MTC未见明显阈值效应，FNA-CT诊断MTC可能存在阈值效应。异质性检验结果显示，FNAC和FNA-CT各诊断效能指标均存在不同程度异质性，故均采用随机效应模型进行合并分析。FNAC诊断MTC的敏感度为0.56（95%CI：0.51~0.61），特异度为0.98（95%CI：0.94~1.00），阳性似然比为34.25（95%CI：8.98~130.62），阴性似然比为0.45（95%CI：0.39~0.51），诊断比值比为76.97（95%CI：18.72~316.52）；FNA-CT诊断MTC的敏感度为0.98（95%CI：0.94~0.99），特异度为0.97（95%CI：0.94~0.99），阳性似然比为37.42（95%CI：16.91~82.80），阴性似然比为0.02（95%CI：0.01~0.06），诊断比值比为1891.55（95%CI：351.09~10 191.13）。FNAC和FNA-CT诊断MTC的SROC曲线下面积分别为0.65和1.00。meta回归分析提示FNAC异质性可能与研究设计和检测方法有关，FNA-CT未发现显著异质性来源；两者可能均存在发表偏倚。Fagan图和似然比点状图显示，FNA-CT对MTC的确诊和排除均具有较高临床价值，而FNAC对MTC具有较好的确诊价值，但排除价值相对有限。结论FNA-CT对MTC具有较高的诊断价值，其总体诊断效能优于FNAC。本研究已在国际系统评价前瞻性注册数据库（PROSPERO）注册（CRD420251243288），并遵循诊断试验准确性研究系统评价和荟萃分析报告规范（PRISMA-DTA）2018。Keywords: 甲状腺髓样癌, 诊断, 细针吸取细胞学检查, 细针吸取洗脱液降钙素测定, 荟萃分析 MTC是一种少见的神经内分泌恶性肿瘤，仅占甲状腺癌的1%~2%［1］。MTC具有高度恶性、浸润性强、早期易发生转移、术后容易复发、预后差等特点［2-3］，因此早期诊断和治疗具有重要意义。当前MTC诊断主要依靠血清降钙素、超声及甲状腺FNAC。对超声检查表现可疑的甲状腺结节或颈部淋巴结常进行FNAC［4］，FNAC对结节性质的诊断及患者治疗方案的制订具有重要意义，是甲状腺结节诊断的金标准。然而，由于MTC组织类型繁多，细胞形态多样，缺乏典型形态特征，约一半的MTC细胞学检查结果为良性、不确定或其他类型肿瘤［5-6］，远低于甲状腺乳头状癌的诊断准确率。2015年美国甲状腺协会指南指出，当FNAC对MTC的诊断结果不明确或提示可能为MTC时，需进一步行FNA-CT，以提高MTC早期诊断检出率［1］。FNA-CT是通过对FNAC提取的液体进行降钙素相关检测来诊断MTC的一种方法。研究显示，FNA-CT可以显著提高MTC诊断的敏感度和特异度［7］。然而，目前对FNA-CT诊断MTC的阈值尚未确定。本研究旨在系统回顾文献并收集数据，通过对FNAC和FNA-CT这两种诊断MTC的方法进行荟萃分析，以期获得较为客观的循证医学证据，提高FNAC和FNA-CT在早期诊断MTC中的应用价值。 资料与方法 文献检索策略 在中国知网、中国生物医学文献数据库、万方数据、维普网、PubMed、Web of Science、Embase、Cochrane中，采用主题词和自由词相结合的方式进行检索。中文检索词为“甲状腺髓样癌”、“细针吸取细胞学检查”、“细针穿刺细胞学检查”、“细针吸取洗脱液降钙素测定”、“细针穿刺洗脱液降钙素测定”、“细针穿刺”、“超声引导下细针穿刺抽吸”、“细针毛细法细胞学”、“针吸活检”，英文检索词为“medullary thyroid carcinoma”、“medullary thyroid cancer”、“thyroid carcinoma， medullary”、“FNA”、“FNAB”、“FNAC”、“FNA-CT”、“US-FNA”、“FNCC”、“fine needle aspiration”、“cytology”、“biopsy”、“washout”、“fluid”。检索时限为1995年1月1日至2024年12月31日。此外，采用手工检索补充文献来源，包括追溯纳入研究的参考文献，以及利用引文追踪检索引用了本次纳入研究的相关文献。 纳入和排除标准 纳入标准：①研究类型为所有公开发表的有关采用FNAC、FNA-CT诊断MTC（甲状腺结节及其颈部淋巴结）的中英文文献，文献类型为前瞻性或回顾性诊断准确性研究的原始研究文献；②研究对象为经甲状腺首次手术或术后病理学检查确诊的MTC患者，不分种族、性别、年龄、国籍和病程，样本量5例及以上；③诊断方法为FNAC及FNA-CT，金标准为术后病理诊断；④能直接提取或根据敏感度、特异度和病例数计算出真阳性、假阳性、假阴性、真阴性、敏感度、特异度、阳性似然比、阴性似然比、诊断比值比及SROC曲线AUC。 排除标准：①非中、英文文献；②动物实验等基础性研究；③综述、会议论文、摘要、讲座、述评、系统评价及病例报告；④无法获取全文或原始研究数据以及数据不全的文献；⑤重复发表的文献；⑥研究对象有MTC手术史或患者合并其他恶性肿瘤等的文献。 文献筛选和资料提取 两名研究者根据预先设定的纳入和排除标准独立进行文献筛选和资料提取，并交叉核对结果。如遇分歧，双方先行讨论以达成共识；若讨论后仍无法达成共识，则由第三名研究者协助裁定。资料提取的内容主要包括：①纳入研究的基本信息（作者、发表年份、研究地区、研究设计等）；②质量评价相关要素；③研究对象/病灶的基本特征（病灶类型、样本量等）；④诊断试验结局指标：提取或计算构建2×2四格表所需的真阳性、假阳性、假阴性、真阴性例数，并据此获得敏感度、特异度等指标。 偏倚风险评价 两名研究者采用QUADAS-2量表对纳入的文献进行偏倚风险评价。评价内容包括偏倚风险和临床适用性两个方面，其中偏倚风险包括病例选择、待评价试验、金标准、流程和时间间隔四个维度，临床适用性包括病例选择、待评价试验和金标准三个维度。每个领域的评价结果分为“低风险”、“高风险”和“不清楚”。两名研究者独立完成文献质量评价，若评价结果存在分歧，则通过讨论协商解决，必要时由第三名研究者协助判断。采用Review Manager 5.4软件绘制偏倚风险汇总图和偏倚风险比例图。 统计学方法 采用Stata 16.0软件进行数据分析。用Spearman秩相关检验评估阈值效应，计算灵敏度对数与（1－特异度）对数之间的相关系数，P<0.05为存在阈值效应。采用Cochran’s Q检验及I²统计量评价研究间异质性。若Q检验P<0.10或I²>50%，则认为存在明显异质性，采用随机效应模型合并效应量；否则认为异质性较小，采用固定效应模型。基于所选模型，对敏感度、特异度、阳性似然比、阴性似然比及诊断比值比进行合并分析，并分别绘制相应指标的森林图；同时绘制SROC曲线，以评估FNAC和FNA-CT对MTC的诊断效能。为探讨异质性来源，进一步进行meta回归分析，纳入的协变量包括研究设计（前瞻性或回顾性）、样本量（n≥40或n<40）、盲法（是或否）、FNAC方法（涂片或涂片+免疫细胞化学法）、截断值确定时间（检测前或检测后）及截断值大小（≥36或<36），若回归系数对应的P<0.05，则认为该变量可能为异质性来源。绘制Deeks漏斗图评估纳入研究是否存在发表偏倚，P<0.05为存在发表偏倚。为评价结果的稳健性，采用逐一剔除法进行敏感性分析。绘制Fagan图和似然比点状图以评价各检测方法的临床效用。其中，Fagan图分析预设验前概率采用默认值20%，结合合并阳性似然比和阴性似然比计算验后概率。 结果 文献筛选结果 中文数据库中检索到29篇相关主题的文献，英文数据库中检索到669篇相关主题的文献，最终纳入13篇文献进行分析，共937例患者，444个MTC病变［8-20］。文献检索及筛选流程见图1。 文献筛选流程图 纳入研究的基本特征和质量评价 纳入研究的基本资料见附表1。QUADAS-2量表评价结果显示，在偏倚风险方面，病例选择有6项研究（46.2%）为低风险、7项研究（53.8%）为不清楚；待评价试验有4项研究（30.8%）为低风险、1项研究（7.7%）为不清楚、8项研究（61.5%）为高风险；金标准有7项研究（53.8%）为低风险、6项研究（46.2%）为不清楚；流程和时间间隔有12项研究（92.3%）为低风险、1项研究（7.7%）为不清楚。见附图1。临床适用性评价显示，纳入研究在病例选择、待评价试验和金标准等三个维度均为低风险。总体来看，纳入研究的临床适用性较好，但病例选择、待评价试验和金标准领域仍存在不确定性，其中待评价试验维度偏倚风险较高。 pmc-13604984.description: Traumatic brain injury (TBI) is a significant public health concern, often resulting in long-term impairments. Inflammasome proteins are carried in extracellular vesicles (EVs) derived from blood plasma and serum.
